bugs.text: Challenging-stage enemies are advanced twice per step: updateEnemy moves them along a path toward slot (0,0) before bullet collision, then updateChallenge moves them onto the drawn path. Shots are tested against positions far from the drawn sprites in the second half of each pass, and waves fly at double speed, so the challenging stage is largely unhittable.
No sound when a normal enemy is destroyed and the 'enemyHit' sound is never played; only boss first hits and the captive's destruction make a hit sound.
Entering and re-entering enemies fly to the raw slot position, then snap to the swayed/scaled formation position, a visible jump of up to ~14 px.
Formation sways, bobs and breathes all at once from the start; no sway-then-breathe phases.
Boss escort list is only reset on non-beam dives, so a boss shot during a later beam dive can count formation Goei as escorts and score 800/1600.
Challenge waveTimer is never reset, so waves 2-5 follow each other with no pause.
player.invuln only flashes the ship; collisions ignore it, so a respawned or half-lost ship can be hit immediately.
After capturing, the boss keeps beaming and swaying for the rest of beamDur (up to 7 s) before returning.
Title-screen controls footer is drawn over the reserve ships at the bottom left (visible in 1-title.png).

summary: A clean, well-organised single file: fixed-timestep loop, clear state/update/render split, and nearly every spec feature is wired up and reachable, including tractor-beam capture, rescue into a working dual fighter whose halves die separately, captives that fire and are destroyed when their boss dies in formation, escort scoring, the two-shot limit, extra ships, the hit-ratio screen, a localStorage high score and arcade flag denominations. It loaded and ran 90 s of bot play with no errors. It is less faithful in motion: entry paths are one Bezier curve per enemy that snaps into a formation which sways and breathes at the same time, sprites are crude blocks, and normal enemy kills are silent. The biggest defect is in the challenging stage, where a double update makes enemies hit-test at positions different from where they are drawn and fly at double speed along non-looping S-curves, so that stage barely works even though its scoring and results screen are coded correctly.
